notes: The supplied object it in and give it unto him is added: no object morpheme stands in that clause (rule 44).

לַאֲשֶׁר … לוֹ is divided as him … whom on the relative (rule 46's first rider) and in respect of on the resumptive preposition, headed on respect by rule 24; the resumptive suffix is unrepresented under rule 22.
